Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Drift
载流子输运现象 - 载流子漂移

1. Carrier Drift  1. 载流子漂移

  • There are two mechanisms that cause charges to move in semiconductors:
    半导体中导致电荷移动的机制有两种：

Drift and Diffusion  漂移和扩散

  • The motion of charge carriers due to the presence of an electric field is known as Drift
    由于电场的存在而导致电荷载流子运动的现象称为漂移
  • Carriers (i.e., electrons and holes) will move under the influence of an electric field because the field will exert a force on the carriers according to:
    载流子（即电子和空穴）将在电场的影响下移动，因为电场会根据以下公式对载流子施加力：
F = Q ⋅ E F = Q ⋅ E F=Q*E\boldsymbol{F}=Q \cdot \boldsymbol{E}
where Q Q QQ is the charge of the carrier ( + e + e +e+e for holes, − e − e -e-e for electrons)
其中 Q Q QQ 是载流子的电荷（孔的电荷为 + e + e +e+e ，电子的电荷为 − e − e -e-e ）

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Drift
载流子输运现象 - 载流子漂移

1. Carrier Drift  1. 载流子漂移

  • Current is the flow rate of the charges.
    电流是电荷的流动速率。
  • So, for the (semi)conductor with a cross-sectional area A, we have
    所以，对于具有横截面积 A 的（半）导体，我们有
I d r i f t = N A Q v d I d r i f t = N A Q v d I_(drift)=NAQv_(d)I_{d r i f t}=N A Q v_{d}
where I drift = I drift  = I_("drift ")=I_{\text {drift }}= drift current (A)
其中 I drift = I drift  = I_("drift ")=I_{\text {drift }}= 漂移电流（安培）
N = N = N=N= carrier density or concentration (per unit volume)
N = N = N=N= 载流子密度或浓度（每单位体积）
A = A = A=A= conductor area   A = A = A=A= 导体面积
Q = Q = Q=Q= carrier charge ©   Q = Q = Q=Q= 载流子电荷 ©
v d = v d = v_(d)=v_{d}= drift velocity of carriers.
v d = v d = v_(d)=v_{d}= 载流子的漂移速度。

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Drift
载流子输运现象 - 载流子漂移

1. Carrier Drift  1. 载流子漂移

  • In the absence of an applied field ( E = 0 E = 0 E=0\mathbf{E = 0} ), the drift velocity of an electron (hole) is zero, but this does not mean that the electron (hole) is stationary.
    在没有施加电场的情况下（ E = 0 E = 0 E=0\mathbf{E = 0} ），电子（空穴）的漂移速度为零，但这并不意味着电子（空穴）是静止的。
  • An electron (hole) has thermal energy and will bounce randomly by interacting with the atoms in the lattice such that its average displacement with time is zero. The random thermal velocity is very high
    电子（空穴）具有热能，并会通过与晶格中的原子相互作用而随机反弹，从而使其随时间的平均位移为零。随机热速度非常高
  • of the order of 10 5 m / s 10 5 m / s 10^(5)m//s10^{5} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s} at room temperature
    在室温下约为 10 5 m / s 10 5 m / s 10^(5)m//s10^{5} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}
  • With an electric field, the electron (hole) will still be scattered by the lattice, but it will experience net motion in the direction of the electric field (in the negative sense for an electron).
    在电场作用下，电子（空穴）仍会受到晶格的散射，但它会在电场方向上（对于电子而言是负方向）经历净运动。
  • The carrier drifts with a much lower velocity, often magnitude of orders lower at low electric fields
    在低电场下，载流子的漂移速度要低得多，通常低几个数量级

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Drift
载流子输运现象 - 载流子漂移

1. Carrier Drift  1. 载流子漂移

  • The drift velocity is the average velocity of all the electrons (holes) in response to an applied electric field. The drift velocity is given by:
    漂移速度是所有电子（空穴）在施加电场下的平均速度。漂移速度由以下公式给出：
v d = − e τ m ∗ E v d = − e τ m ∗ E v_(d)=(-e tau)/(m^(**))Ev_{d}=\frac{-e \tau}{m^{*}} E
where τ τ tau\tau is the mean time between collisions (or the mean scattering time or relaxation time), and E E EE is the external (applied) electric field (since any internal fields are already taken into account by the effective mass m ∗ m ∗ m^(**)m^{*} )
其中 τ τ tau\tau 是碰撞之间的平均时间（或平均散射时间或弛豫时间）， E E EE 是外部（施加的）电场（因为任何内部场已经通过有效质量 m ∗ m ∗ m^(**)m^{*} 考虑在内）
  • The drift velocity increases linearly with the applied field (at small fields)
    漂移速度在施加的电场（在小电场下）下线性增加
  • The constant of proportionality, e τ / m ∗ e τ / m ∗ etau//m^(**)\mathrm{e} \tau / m^{*}, is called the drift mobility, and is given by: μ = − e τ m ∗ μ = − e τ m ∗ mu=(-e tau)/(m^(**))\mu=\frac{-e \tau}{m^{*}}
    比例常数 e τ / m ∗ e τ / m ∗ etau//m^(**)\mathrm{e} \tau / m^{*} 被称为漂移迁移率，表示为： μ = − e τ m ∗ μ = − e τ m ∗ mu=(-e tau)/(m^(**))\mu=\frac{-e \tau}{m^{*}}
  • Drift mobility ( cm 2 / V . s cm 2 / V . s cm^(2)//V.s\mathrm{cm}^{2} / \mathrm{V} . \mathrm{s} ) is an indicator of how fast electrons will drift when driven by an applied field. If the electron is not highly scattered, then the mean scattering time τ τ tau\tau will be long, and hence μ μ mu\mu will be large - the electrons are highly “mobile”
    漂移迁移率（ cm 2 / V . s cm 2 / V . s cm^(2)//V.s\mathrm{cm}^{2} / \mathrm{V} . \mathrm{s} ）是电子在施加电场驱动下漂移速度的指标。如果电子没有被高度散射，则平均散射时间 τ τ tau\tau 将很长，因此 μ μ mu\mu 将很大 - 电子是高度“可移动”的

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Drift
载流子输运现象 - 载流子漂移

  • Mobility is a positive quantity. As electrons and holes move in opposite directions for the same electric field, the relations between drift velocity and electric fields are:
    迁移率是一个正值。当电子和空穴在相同电场下朝相反方向移动时，漂移速度与电场之间的关系为：
Electrons: v d = − μ n E v d = − μ n E v_(d)=-mu_(n)Ev_{d}=-\mu_{n} E  电子： v d = − μ n E v d = − μ n E v_(d)=-mu_(n)Ev_{d}=-\mu_{n} E
Holes: v d = μ p E v d = μ p E quadv_(d)=mu_(p)E\quad v_{d}=\mu_{p} E  空穴： v d = μ p E v d = μ p E quadv_(d)=mu_(p)E\quad v_{d}=\mu_{p} E
  • For convenience we normally deal with current densities rather than current, hence:
    为了方便，我们通常处理电流密度而不是电流，因此：
Electrons: J n , drift = ( − e ) n v d = ( − e ) n ( − μ n E ) = e n μ n E J n ,  drift  = ( − e ) n v d = ( − e ) n − μ n E = e n μ n E quadJ_(n," drift ")=(-e)nv_(d)=(-e)n(-mu_(n)E)=enmu_(n)E\quad J_{n, \text { drift }}=(-e) n v_{d}=(-e) n\left(-\mu_{n} E\right)=e n \mu_{n} E  电子： J n , drift = ( − e ) n v d = ( − e ) n ( − μ n E ) = e n μ n E J n ,  drift  = ( − e ) n v d = ( − e ) n − μ n E = e n μ n E quadJ_(n," drift ")=(-e)nv_(d)=(-e)n(-mu_(n)E)=enmu_(n)E\quad J_{n, \text { drift }}=(-e) n v_{d}=(-e) n\left(-\mu_{n} E\right)=e n \mu_{n} E
Holes: J p , drift = ( + e ) p v d = ( + e ) p ( μ p E ) = e p μ p E J p ,  drift  = ( + e ) p v d = ( + e ) p μ p E = e p μ p E quadJ_(p," drift ")=(+e)pv_(d)=(+e)p(mu_(p)E)=epmu_(p)E\quad J_{p, \text { drift }}=(+e) p v_{d}=(+e) p\left(\mu_{p} E\right)=e p \mu_{p} E  空穴： J p , drift = ( + e ) p v d = ( + e ) p ( μ p E ) = e p μ p E J p ,  drift  = ( + e ) p v d = ( + e ) p μ p E = e p μ p E quadJ_(p," drift ")=(+e)pv_(d)=(+e)p(mu_(p)E)=epmu_(p)E\quad J_{p, \text { drift }}=(+e) p v_{d}=(+e) p\left(\mu_{p} E\right)=e p \mu_{p} E
(a) J J JJ is proportional to E E EE : this is generally true for metals, and for semiconductors at relatively low electric fields.
(a) J J JJ 与 E E EE 成正比：这通常对于金属和在相对低电场下的半导体是正确的。
(b) Direction of current flow is the same for both electrons & holes.
（b）电流流动方向对于电子和空穴是相同的。
© J depends on both mobility μ μ mu\mu AND carrier concentration n n nn (or p). Semiconductors have very low carrier concentrations (typ. 10 13 − 10 18 cm − 3 10 13 − 10 18 cm − 3 10^(13)-10^(18)cm^(-3)10^{13}-10^{18} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} ) compared to metals ( 10 23 cm − 3 ) 10 23 cm − 3 (10^(23)cm^(-3))\left(10^{23} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}\right), but higher mobilities in general.
© J 取决于迁移率 μ μ mu\mu 和载流子浓度 n n nn （或 p）。与金属 ( 10 23 cm − 3 ) 10 23 cm − 3 (10^(23)cm^(-3))\left(10^{23} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}\right) 相比，半导体的载流子浓度非常低（典型值 10 13 − 10 18 cm − 3 10 13 − 10 18 cm − 3 10^(13)-10^(18)cm^(-3)10^{13}-10^{18} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} ），但一般具有更高的迁移率。

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Drift
载流子输运现象 - 载流子漂移

  • The total drift current density in a semiconductor is contributed by both electrons and holes, so
    半导体中的总漂移电流密度由电子和空穴共同贡献，因此
J drift = J n , drift + J p , drift = e n μ n E + e p μ p E = e ( n μ n + p μ p ) E J drift = J n , drift + J p , drift = e n μ n E + e p μ p E = e n μ n + p μ p E {:[J_(drift)=J_(n,drift)+J_(p,drift)],[=enmu_(n)E+epmu_(p)E],[=e(nmu_(n)+pmu_(p))E]:}\begin{aligned} J_{\mathrm{drift}} & =J_{\mathrm{n}, \mathrm{drift}}+J_{\mathrm{p}, \mathrm{drift}} \\ & =e n \mu_{\mathrm{n}} E+e p \mu_{\mathrm{p}} E \\ & =e\left(n \mu_{\mathrm{n}}+p \mu_{\mathrm{p}}\right) E \end{aligned}
  • From Ohm’s law:  根据欧姆定律：
J = σ E J = σ E J=sigma EJ=\sigma E
where σ = 1 / ρ σ = 1 / ρ sigma=1//rho\sigma=1 / \rho is the conductivity (and is the resistivity), we have
其中 σ = 1 / ρ σ = 1 / ρ sigma=1//rho\sigma=1 / \rho 是导电率（而是电阻率），我们有
σ = e ( n μ n + p μ p ) σ = e n μ n + p μ p sigma=e(nmu_(n)+pmu_(p))\sigma=e\left(n \mu_{\mathrm{n}}+p \mu_{\mathrm{p}}\right)
  • In most cases, for a doped semiconductor, the majority carrier concentration is much greater than that of the minority carrier in which case:
    在大多数情况下，对于掺杂半导体，主要载流子浓度远大于少数载流子浓度，此时：
    n-type: σ ≅ e n μ n σ ≅ e n μ n sigma~=enmu_(n)\sigma \cong e n \mu_{\mathrm{n}}, p-type: σ ≅ e p μ p σ ≅ e p μ p sigma~=epmu_(p)\sigma \cong e p \mu_{\mathrm{p}}
    n 型： σ ≅ e n μ n σ ≅ e n μ n sigma~=enmu_(n)\sigma \cong e n \mu_{\mathrm{n}} ，p 型： σ ≅ e p μ p σ ≅ e p μ p sigma~=epmu_(p)\sigma \cong e p \mu_{\mathrm{p}}

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Mobility
载流子输运现象 - 载流子迁移率

2. Carrier Mobility  2. 载流子迁移率

The carrier mobility depends on several factors:
载流子迁移率取决于几个因素：

A. Semiconductor properties
A. 半导体特性

  • In particular, the smaller the effective mass of a carrier, the higher the mobility, since a carrier can be accelerated more easily given the same force ( | F | = m ∗ | a | = e | E | | F | = m ∗ | a | = e | E | |F|=m^(**)|a|=e|E||F|=m^{*}|a|=e|E| ).
    特别是，载流子的有效质量越小，迁移率越高，因为在相同的力作用下，载流子可以更容易地被加速（ | F | = m ∗ | a | = e | E | | F | = m ∗ | a | = e | E | |F|=m^(**)|a|=e|E||F|=m^{*}|a|=e|E| ）。

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Mobility
载流子输运现象 - 载流子迁移率

B. Thermal (lattice) scattering
B. 热（晶格）散射

  • Carriers are scattered by thermal vibrations of the lattice atoms (phonons). Hence the mobility decreases with increasing temperature
    载流子受到晶格原子（声子）热振动的散射。因此，迁移率随着温度的升高而降低
  • To first order,  首先，
μ L ∝ T − 3 / 2 μ L ∝ T − 3 / 2 mu_(L)propT^(-3//2)\mu_{L} \propto T^{-3 / 2}
where μ L μ L mu_(L)\mu_{\mathrm{L}} is the mobility that would be observed if only lattice scattering were present
当仅存在晶格散射时， μ L μ L mu_(L)\mu_{\mathrm{L}} 是观察到的迁移率

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Mobility
载流子输运现象 - 载流子迁移率

C. Scattering by lattice defects
C. 晶格缺陷的散射

  • Not significant in single-crystal silicon used in IC manufacturing (since there are few such defects), but is important in devices made from polysilicon or amorphous silicon (e.g. thin-film transistors in LCD displays).
    在用于集成电路制造的单晶硅中并不显著（因为这种缺陷很少），但在由多晶硅或非晶硅制成的器件中（例如液晶显示器中的薄膜晶体管）则很重要。
Scattering of electron by dislocation
位错对电子的散射

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Mobility
载流子输运现象 - 载流子迁移率

D. Scattering by ionized impurities
D. 被电离杂质的散射

  • Impurities in the lattice scatter the carriers and hence the larger the concentration of impurities, the lower the mobility
    晶格中的杂质散射载流子，因此杂质浓度越大，迁移率越低
  • The main impurities in silicon are dopants, as well as impurities such as oxygen and carbon that originated from the silicon crystal growth process, but the impurity concentrations are very low in percentage terms, and would normally have little effect if they were neutral.
    硅中的主要杂质是掺杂剂，以及来自硅晶体生长过程的氧和碳等杂质，但杂质浓度在百分比上非常低，通常如果它们是中性的，几乎不会产生影响。
Scattering of electron by neutral impurities
电子与中性杂质的散射

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Mobility
载流子输运现象 - 载流子迁移率

  • If the impurities were ionized (i.e. ionized dopant) then each impurity has a charge on it whose electrostatic field extends a considerable distance from the impurity itself.
    如果杂质被电离（即电离掺杂剂），那么每个杂质都有一个电荷，其静电场从杂质本身延伸到相当远的距离。
  • Such charged impurities can exert a considerable long-range scattering effect on charge carriers despite their small numbers.
    尽管带电杂质数量很少，但它们仍然可以对电荷载流子产生相当大的长程散射效应。

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Mobility
载流子输运现象 - 载流子迁移率

  • The total (not net) ionized dopant concentration ( N A − + N D + ) N A − + N D + (N_(A)^(-)+N_(D)^(+))\left(\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}}{ }^{-}+\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{D}}{ }^{+}\right)affects the mobility
    总的（而非净的）离子化掺杂剂浓度 ( N A − + N D + ) N A − + N D + (N_(A)^(-)+N_(D)^(+))\left(\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}}{ }^{-}+\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{D}}{ }^{+}\right) 影响迁移率
  • it does not matter whether the ionized impurity is negative or positive, it will still scatter an electron or hole.
    无论离子杂质是负的还是正的，它仍然会散射电子或空穴。
  • To first order, we have μ I ∝ T 3 / 2 N A − + N D + μ I ∝ T 3 / 2 N A − + N D + mu_(I)prop(T^(3//2))/(N_(A)^(-)+N_(D)^(+))\mu_{\mathrm{I}} \propto \frac{T^{3 / 2}}{N_{\mathrm{A}}^{-}+N_{\mathrm{D}}^{+}}
    从第一阶来看，我们有 μ I ∝ T 3 / 2 N A − + N D + μ I ∝ T 3 / 2 N A − + N D + mu_(I)prop(T^(3//2))/(N_(A)^(-)+N_(D)^(+))\mu_{\mathrm{I}} \propto \frac{T^{3 / 2}}{N_{\mathrm{A}}^{-}+N_{\mathrm{D}}^{+}}
    where μ I μ I mu_(I)\mu_{\mathrm{I}} is the mobility that would be observed if only ionized impurity scattering were present

3. Carrier Diffusion  3. 载流子扩散

  • The second mechanism, apart from drift, that can cause electrons and holes to move is diffusion.
    除了漂移之外，导致电子和空穴移动的第二种机制是扩散。
  • Diffusion is a general phenomenon where there is a net movement of particles from a region of higher concentration to a region of lower concentration.
    扩散是一种普遍现象，粒子从高浓度区域向低浓度区域发生净移动。
  • For charge carriers, if there is a concentration gradient, diffusion occurs and this leads to net carrier
    对于电荷载流子，如果存在浓度梯度，就会发生扩散，从而导致净载流子
Diffusion flux and hence current flow.
扩散通量，因此电流流动。

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Carrier Diffusion
载流子输运现象 - 载流子扩散

  • The flux (number of particles per second) is proportional to the concentration gradient.
    通量（每秒粒子数）与浓度梯度成正比。
  • For electrons:  对于电子：

    where D n D n D_(n)D_{\mathrm{n}} is the diffusion coefficient or diffusivity for electrons, which is the constant of x proportionality that gives a measure of how easy it is for the electron to diffuse.
    其中 D n D n D_(n)D_{\mathrm{n}} 是电子的扩散系数或扩散率，它是一个与 x 成正比的常数，衡量电子扩散的难易程度。
  • The minus sign before the concentration term, d n / d x d n / d x dn//dx\mathrm{d} n / \mathrm{d} x, indicates that the electrons diffuse from a higher to lower concentration
    浓度项 d n / d x d n / d x dn//dx\mathrm{d} n / \mathrm{d} x 前的负号表示电子从高浓度扩散到低浓度

Carrier Transport Phenomena - Einstein Relation
载流子输运现象 - 爱因斯坦关系

4. Einstein Relation  4. 爱因斯坦关系

  • The diffusion coefficient, D n D n D_(n)D_{\mathrm{n}} or D p D p D_(p)D_{\mathrm{p}}, is a measure of ease of carrier diffusion motion in a medium, while the mobility, μ n μ n mu_(n)\mu_{\mathrm{n}} or μ p μ p mu_(p)\mu_{\mathrm{p}}, is a measure of the ease of carrier drift in the same medium.
    扩散系数 D n D n D_(n)D_{\mathrm{n}} 或 D p D p D_(p)D_{\mathrm{p}} 是衡量载流子在介质中扩散运动的难易程度，而迁移率 μ n μ n mu_(n)\mu_{\mathrm{n}} 或 μ p μ p mu_(p)\mu_{\mathrm{p}} 是衡量载流子在同一介质中漂移的难易程度。
  • It is therefore not surprising that the two quantities are related by the Einstein Relation,
    因此，这两个量通过爱因斯坦关系相互关联并不令人惊讶，
D n μ n = D p μ p = k T e D n μ n = D p μ p = k T e (D_(n))/(mu_(n))=(D_(p))/(mu_(p))=(kT)/(e)\frac{D_{n}}{\mu_{n}}=\frac{D_{p}}{\mu_{p}}=\frac{k T}{e}
  • According to the Einstein Relation, the ratios of the diffusion coefficient to mobility for electrons and holes are equal and depend on the temperature T T TT only. k k kk is the Boltzmann constant ( 1.381 × 10 − 23 JK − 1 1.381 × 10 − 23 JK − 1 1.381 xx10^(-23)JK^(-1)1.381 \times 10^{-23} \mathrm{JK}^{-1} )
    根据爱因斯坦关系，电子和空穴的扩散系数与迁移率的比率是相等的，并且仅依赖于温度 T T TT 。 k k kk 是玻尔兹曼常数 ( 1.381 × 10 − 23 JK − 1 1.381 × 10 − 23 JK − 1 1.381 xx10^(-23)JK^(-1)1.381 \times 10^{-23} \mathrm{JK}^{-1} )
  • Note that k T = 0.0259 eV k T = 0.0259 eV kT=0.0259eVk T=0.0259 \mathrm{eV} at T = 300 K T = 300 K T=300KT=300 \mathrm{~K}, or k T / e = 0.0259 V k T / e = 0.0259 V kT//e=0.0259Vk T / e=0.0259 \mathrm{~V}.
    请注意 k T = 0.0259 eV k T = 0.0259 eV kT=0.0259eVk T=0.0259 \mathrm{eV} 在 T = 300 K T = 300 K T=300KT=300 \mathrm{~K} 或 k T / e = 0.0259 V k T / e = 0.0259 V kT//e=0.0259Vk T / e=0.0259 \mathrm{~V} 。

5. Total Current  5. 总电流

In summary, we have the following relationships:
总之，我们有以下关系：

Drift  漂移

  • Motion of charge carriers due to the presence of an electric field ( E ≠ 0 ) ( E ≠ 0 ) (E!=0)(E \neq 0) giving rise to drift current
    由于电场的存在，电荷载流子的运动 ( E ≠ 0 ) ( E ≠ 0 ) (E!=0)(E \neq 0) 导致漂移电流
Electrons: J n , drift = e n μ n E Holes: J p , drift = e p μ p E  Electrons:  J n , drift = e n μ n E  Holes:  J p , drift = e p μ p E " Electrons: "J_(n,drift)=enmu_(n)E quad" Holes: "J_(p,drift)=epmu_(p)E\text { Electrons: } J_{\mathrm{n}, \mathrm{drift}}=e n \mu_{\mathrm{n}} E \quad \text { Holes: } J_{\mathrm{p}, \mathrm{drift}}=e p \mu_{\mathrm{p}} E

Diffusion  扩散

  • Motion of charge carriers due to the presence of concentration gradient ( d n / d x ≠ 0 d n / d x ≠ 0 dn//dx!=0d n / d x \neq 0 or d p / d x ≠ 0 d p / d x ≠ 0 dp//dx!=0d p / d x \neq 0 ) giving rise to diffusion current
    由于浓度梯度（ d n / d x ≠ 0 d n / d x ≠ 0 dn//dx!=0d n / d x \neq 0 或 d p / d x ≠ 0 d p / d x ≠ 0 dp//dx!=0d p / d x \neq 0 ）的存在，电荷载流子的运动导致扩散电流
Electrons: J n , diff = e D n ( d n / d x ) Holes: J p , diff = e D p ( d p / d x )  Electrons:  J n , diff = e D n ( d n / d x )  Holes:  J p , diff = e D p ( d p / d x ) " Electrons: "J_(n,diff)=eD_(n)(dn//dx)quad" Holes: "J_(p,diff)=eD_(p)(dp//dx)\text { Electrons: } J_{\mathrm{n}, \mathrm{diff}}=e D_{\mathrm{n}}(d n / d x) \quad \text { Holes: } J_{\mathrm{p}, \mathrm{diff}}=e D_{\mathrm{p}}(d p / d x)

Einstein Relation  爱因斯坦关系

  • Relates the diffusivity of the mobility
    关联迁移率的扩散性
D n μ n = D p μ p = k T e D n μ n = D p μ p = k T e (D_(n))/(mu_(n))=(D_(p))/(mu_(p))=(kT)/(e)\frac{D_{n}}{\mu_{n}}=\frac{D_{p}}{\mu_{p}}=\frac{k T}{e}

5. Total Current  5. 总电流

  • In general, if both an electric field and a concentration gradient are present, the carriers will drift and diffuse
    一般来说，如果同时存在电场和浓度梯度，载流子将会漂移和扩散
  • The equations for the electron current density, J n J n J_(n)J_{n}, and the hole current density, J p J p J_(p)J_{p}, are the sum of the drift and diffusion components:
    电子电流密度 J n J n J_(n)J_{n} 和孔电流密度 J p J p J_(p)J_{p} 的方程是漂移和扩散分量的总和：

Electron current density
电子电流密度

J n = J n , drift + J n , diff = e n μ n E + e D n ( d n / d x ) J n = J n , drift + J n , diff = e n μ n E + e D n ( d n / d x ) {:[J_(n)=J_(n,drift)+J_(n,diff)],[=enmu_(n)E+eD_(n)(dn//dx)]:}\begin{aligned} J_{\mathrm{n}} & =J_{\mathrm{n}, \mathrm{drift}}+J_{\mathrm{n}, \mathrm{diff}} \\ & =e n \mu_{\mathrm{n}} E+e D_{\mathrm{n}}(d n / d x) \end{aligned}

Hole current density  孔电流密度

J p = J p , drift + J p diff = e p μ p E − e D p ( d p / d x ) J p = J p ,  drift  + J p  diff  = e p μ p E − e D p ( d p / d x ) {:[J_(p)=J_(p," drift ")+J_(p" diff ")],[=epmu_(p)E-eD_(p)(dp//dx)]:}\begin{aligned} J_{\mathrm{p}} & =J_{\mathrm{p}, \text { drift }}+J_{\mathrm{p} \text { diff }} \\ & =e p \mu_{\mathrm{p}} E-e D_{\mathrm{p}}(d p / d x) \end{aligned}
  • The total current density, J J JJ, in a semiconductor is the sum of contributions from electrons and holes,
    半导体中的总电流密度 J J JJ 是电子和孔的贡献之和，
J n = J n + J p = ( J n , drift + J n , diff ) + ( J p , drift + J p ,diff ) = e ( n μ n + p μ p ) E + e [ D n ( d n / d x ) − e D p ( d p / d x ) ] J n = J n + J p = J n ,  drift  + J n ,  diff  + J p ,  drift  + J p ,diff  = e n μ n + p μ p E + e D n ( d n / d x ) − e D p ( d p / d x ) {:[J_(n)=J_(n)+J_(p)],[=(J_(n," drift ")+J_(n," diff "))+(J_(p," drift ")+J_(p",diff "))],[=e(nmu_(n)+pmu_(p))E+e[D_(n)(dn//dx)-eD_(p)(dp//dx)]]:}\begin{aligned} J_{\mathrm{n}} & =J_{\mathrm{n}}+J_{\mathrm{p}} \\ & =\left(J_{\mathrm{n}, \text { drift }}+J_{\mathrm{n}, \text { diff }}\right)+\left(J_{\mathrm{p}, \text { drift }}+J_{\mathrm{p} \text {,diff }}\right) \\ & =e\left(n \mu_{\mathrm{n}}+p \mu_{\mathrm{p}}\right) E+e\left[D_{\mathrm{n}}(d n / d x)-e D_{\mathrm{p}}(d p / d x)\right] \end{aligned}

    300K 下的有效质量和载流子迁移率
